business_problem: SiB Solutions needed a scalable, open and low-error way to process warehouse video and logistics events across customer sites without getting trapped in rigid monolithic architectures or vendor lock-in.
solution_summary: SiB Solutions built its intelligent video and AI services on IBM Cloud beginning in 2020, using IBM Code Engine and IBM Event Streams, the managed Apache Kafka service, as the backbone for warehouse telemetry and video events. In customer warehouses, video analytics run onsite for data residency, and edge computers apply deep-learning models to the camera feeds so errors can be identified close to the process being observed. Those outputs are published by Kafka producers to Kafka topics and sent to cloud servers, where application logic executes and microservices coordinate logistics workflows. Event Streams gives the company the high-volume streaming fabric it needed to avoid brittle monoliths and connect onsite industrial environments to cloud services, while Code Engine supports the cloud-side runtime used to develop and operate the broader platform.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the cloud servers and broader platform that receive warehouse events and run application logic.

solution_components.name: IBM Code Engine
solution_components.role: Supports the cloud-side runtime used to develop and operate the logistics application services.

solution_components.name: IBM Event Streams
solution_components.role: Carries high-volume Kafka event streams between onsite edge processing and cloud microservices.

data_flow: Video is analyzed onsite in customer warehouses, edge computers process the footage with deep-learning models, and Kafka producers send the resulting events through IBM Event Streams to cloud servers on IBM Cloud where application logic and microservices coordinate logistics actions.
business_outcome: The platform supports more than 30 sites across Europe and North America while helping SiB Solutions reduce infrastructure and operational expenses and deliver logistics services designed to eliminate costly warehouse errors.
